product_overview: GramSeva is a secure, transparent village grievance redressal system that lets citizens and guests submit local complaints, route them to the correct village authority, and track resolution progress. It also provides role-based administrative controls for village admins and super admins to manage village access, approvals, and complaint oversight.
core_goals: Enable citizens and anonymous users to submit community complaints with geo-based village routing
Provide ticket-based complaint tracking for submitted grievances
Support village membership via unique join codes for authenticated citizens
Allow super admins to approve or reject village admin promotion requests
Provide administrative access to village join codes for setup and support

features.name: Complaint Submission API
features.description: Allows citizens or guest users to submit a new complaint with title, description, category, coordinates, optional photos, and anonymous options. The complaint is stored against the correct village, with automatic geographic boundary resolution when location data is provided.
user_flows: POST /rpc/svc_create_complaint with valid complaint details and coordinates -> Receive 200 with success true, complaint_id, and ticket_id -> Use ticket_id to track the complaint lifecycle

POST /rpc/svc_create_complaint with valid complaint details and anonymous submission fields -> Receive 200 with success true and generated ticket_id -> Complaint is created without exposing the reporter's identity
POST /rpc/svc_create_complaint with missing or invalid title/category/location fields -> Receive 200 with success false and error message -> Complaint is not created

POST /rpc/svc_create_complaint with coordinates that do not resolve to a known village boundary -> Receive 200 with success false or error indicating routing failure/manual village selection needed -> Complaint is not created until a valid village context is provided

features.name: Village Membership Management
features.description: Lets authenticated users join a village using a unique village join code so they can become registered citizens of that village.
user_flows: POST /rpc/svc_join_village with a valid join code while authenticated -> Receive 200 with success true, village_id, and village_name -> User becomes a member of the village
POST /rpc/svc_join_village with an invalid or expired join code while authenticated -> Receive 200 with success false and error message -> User remains unassigned to the village
POST /rpc/svc_join_village without authentication -> Receive an authorization failure from the API -> Village membership is not changed

features.name: Admin Verification & Approval
features.description: Enables super admins to approve or reject village admin promotion requests and manage admin access workflows.
user_flows: POST /rpc/svc_approve_admin_request with a valid request_id as a super admin -> Receive 200 with success true, village details, join_code, and user_id -> Requested user is promoted to village admin
POST /rpc/svc_reject_admin_request with a valid request_id as a super admin -> Receive 200 with success true -> Admin promotion request is rejected and no promotion occurs
POST /rpc/svc_approve_admin_request with an invalid request_id or unauthorized role -> Receive 200 with success false or an authorization failure -> No admin is promoted
POST /rpc/svc_reject_admin_request with an invalid request_id -> Receive 200 with success false and error message -> Request remains unresolved or is not processed

features.name: Village Setup & Join Codes
features.description: Provides authenticated administrative access to fetch the current join code for a specific village during village setup or support workflows.
user_flows: POST /rpc/get_current_village_join_code with a valid village id as an authenticated admin -> Receive 200 with the current join code string -> Admin shares the code with eligible users
POST /rpc/get_current_village_join_code with an invalid village id -> Receive 200 with an error string or empty response -> Join code is not returned
POST /rpc/get_current_village_join_code without authentication -> Receive an authorization failure from the API -> Join code remains protected
